name: Active Cash Card

verdict.text: Keep for the simplicity: a flat 2% on everything, no categories to track

earn_note: One rate on every purchase, with no rotating categories, no spending caps, and no activation. Excludes cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest charges, and wire transfers.

redemption_options.method: Statement credit or direct deposit to a Wells Fargo account
Pay with Rewards at PayPal checkout
Gift cards from 250+ merchants (e-gift cards from $10)

points.note: A flat 1 cent per dollar however it's redeemed. There's no premium redemption path (no travel portal bonus, no transfer partners), so the value never moves from 2% cash back.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer currency. This is straight cash back, not a points program.

insurance.detail: Up to $600 per claim against damage or theft when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with this card, minus a $25 deductible, max 2 claims per 12 months
Secondary coverage only, applies after your personal auto insurance
Not responsible for unauthorized transactions once reported

protection_note: Cell phone protection is a real, above-average benefit for a no-fee card. Beyond that, coverage is thin: no purchase protection, extended warranty, or trip insurance are advertised, and rental car coverage is secondary only.
rental_note: Secondary coverage only, meaning it pays after your personal auto policy for whatever's left. Charge the full rental cost to the card and decline the counter's optional CDW to activate it.

services.name: $200 welcome bonus
services.detail: One-time $200 cash rewards bonus after spending $500 in purchases within the first 3 months.

services.name: 0% intro APR
services.detail: 0% for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (transfers must be made within 120 days of account opening), then a variable 18.49%, 24.49%, or 28.49% APR.

services.name: Foreign transaction fee
services.detail: 3% of each transaction, converted to US dollars.

services.name: Visa Signature Concierge
services.detail: 24/7 complimentary concierge for reservations, event tickets, and travel planning.

services.name: Roadside Dispatch
services.detail: 24/7 towing and roadside assistance, billed to the card at time of dispatch, no membership fee.

services.name: Credit Close-Up
services.detail: Free monthly FICO score updates and credit report insights through the Wells Fargo app.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns 2% cash rewards on their spend (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add, and their spending earns the same flat 2% into your account.

timeline.text: Wells Fargo launches Active Cash as its flagship flat-rate cash back card, replacing the Propel as the bank's main no-annual-fee rewards product.
